No.20572 of 2025 and Crl.M.P(MD) Nos.17457 and 17458 of 2025 Jahankir Abbas Vs 1.The Second Class Executive Magistrate Cum Tashildar, Ramanathapuram, Ramanathapuram District. 2. The State of Tamilnadu, Rep by the Inspector of Police, Mandapam Police Station, Ramanathapuram District. Prayer :- This Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 52 Bnss, to call for the entire records of the proceedings initiated b respondent in Mc No.A3/216/2025/4901/2025 dated 24.10.2025 and quash the said proceedings as against the petitioner. For Petitioner: Mr.B.Arun, Advocate. For Respondents : Mr.K.Sanjai Gandhi, Additional Public Prosecutor 1/8 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
